name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
Zero-Lag 120 FPS Fluidity: Removed 165+ translateZ hardware compositing layers and eliminated background continuous blob repaint loops. Completely smooth 60/120 FPS scrolling.
Search Suggestions Overhaul: Completely unclipped suggestions dropdown, now cleanly positioned directly under the search bar with instant dismiss and zero button interference.
Category Tabs Layout Fix: Made All, Videos, and Photos/Wallpapers responsive (flex: 1 1 0) so no tab is ever cut off or pushed off-screen.
Instant CDN Cache-Busting: Added real-time timestamp cache busting for seamless in-app update checks and downloads.
